discovery.intro: Explore quizzes from general knowledge and math to brain teasers.

categoryDescriptions.general: Check everyday facts across a broad mix of subjects.
categoryDescriptions.nonsense: Solve short riddles by looking for a playful twist in the wording.
categoryDescriptions.math: Practice calculation and reasoning, from arithmetic to sequences and probability.
categoryDescriptions.brain: Use clues, number patterns, and logical steps to find an answer.
categoryDescriptions.history: Explore factual milestones, people, and events from ancient to modern history.
categoryDescriptions.science: Review basic ideas in biology, chemistry, physics, and space.
categoryDescriptions.geography: Recall where continents, countries, capitals, and natural features are found.
categoryDescriptions.language: Explore vocabulary, grammar, and writing systems across languages.
categoryDescriptions.technology: Review foundations of the web, programming, databases, and networks.
categoryDescriptions.memory: Remember numbers, words, and sequences or spot visual changes.
categoryDescriptions.random: Play a fresh mix of questions drawn from several subjects.
categoryDescriptions.challenge: Stay focused through a fixed set of consecutive questions.
categoryDescriptions.speed: Measure reaction time, clicking, or typing speed directly.
categoryDescriptions.fun: Take a short break with light trivia and playful challenges.

serviceGuide.account: Choose a quiz and select an answer for each question. No account is needed; results stay in this browser.
serviceGuide.score: How should I read my score?
serviceGuide.scoreLow: This topic is worth more practice. Read the explanations and try again.
serviceGuide.scoreMid: You know the basics. Review the explanations for questions you missed.
serviceGuide.scoreHigh: You did well on this set. Try another subject or a fresh set of questions.
serviceGuide.scoreNote: Your score is the accuracy for this set, not a diagnosis of ability or health.
